selection.timeout_rationale: The unchanged 1685-call Qwen3.5 protocol has a row-length estimate of 2.8835 prefill hours from the completed pruned short/2K/16K runs. Including about 217 s startup/initial verification, up to 396 decode forwards approximated at 0.5275 s each (get_logits only), and 630 s discretionary serialization/hash/lazy-initialization allowances gives 3.1769 h; 25%/50% prefill-slowdown scenarios give 3.8977 h/4.6186 h. A 6 h fail-stop cap allows margin but does not guarantee completion. The Qwen3 Speed cap is 2 h: the older 4K full protocol proxy was about 28 min, while this fresh 16K artifact may differ; this is an operational allowance, not a measured 16K estimate. See [private derivation file] (SHA256 aa75676c25c9c03aebfed71205ef2439af3fa916ed907cdbd4530774c10a2666). Deadlines do not change workloads or trigger automatic retries.

limits: 20 GiB is a process/Job committed-memory limit, not a bound on driver/NPU memory. The queue serializes its children; exclusivity against unrelated NPU processes is operational.
